case_number: Civil Appeal No. 1491 of 2023 (Arising out of SLP(Civil) No. 22557 of 2019)
summary: Landmark property dispute involving alleged fraud in sale deed execution; key issue: co-ownership vs partnership property characterization; plaintiff claimed signing sale deed as security document but Trial Court dismissed suit for failure to prove fraud; High Court affirmed partition decrees but ordered de novo trial for fraudulent sale claim due to incomplete evidence; standard: Section 103 Evidence Act burden applies; no reexamination of Sub Registrar by plaintiff; partnership properties determined as co-owned assets after analyzing partnership deed terms; unregistered partnership suit for injunction held barred under Section 69(1) Partnership Act; appeal challenged cancellation of 2006 sale deed concerning cinema theatre property.
final_judgment: Leave granted; appeal allowed in part; High Court's direction for de novo trial upheld but partition decrees affirmed; fraud claim remanded for fresh consideration while maintaining co-ownership characterization of property.
